The reason for the degradation are unlearned BIAS values "Mobs_t_LearnBias" has a value of ~12,3 s, which is less than the required value of greater than 40 s for a learned bias. This indicates that the bias has not been learned correct yet. Information to BIAS: The BIAS values are learned offset values used by the Kalman filter to estimate speed/acceleration in dynamic situations when the pure wheel speeds can no longer be trusted. The speed V_VEH_COG (from the Kalman filter) is only QM. Therefore, in the case of a deviation from the EgoSafe speed, a switch must be made. An unlearned bias can cause the speed to drift, leading to more FuSi-intervention because a delta between EgoMobs and EgoSafe occurs due to deviations within the wheel speeds. How are the BIAS values learned: Bias islearned at a high yaw rate (rotation around z), but little lateral acceleration (max. 2-3 m/s^2). A few laps slowly around a parking lot or something like a few laps in a roundabout. Alternating left/right is also good, so that the bias is cleanly learned in all directions. After each clamp change, the values are written to the EPROM. In the next driving cycle, the values continue to be learned. Left and right values can occasionally reset. -> Expected Behaviour, please learn the BIAS values [Comment 5 | id: 6872201 | timestamp: 2025-04-30T07:28:21Z | author: Dominikus Haegel] EF-252 Q-Gate: Analysis will be done by EgoMotion Analysis Team. Detail is in 'OK_vehicle info.zip', which contains checkin, Can trace, ETH trace and pre-analysis. === end of error description === Delong Jia, EC-ES-2, 08/04/2025 According to the DC_CAN trace, the charging failed reason is vehicle send BEM message incorrectly. In GBT 27930 standard, the conditions for a vehicle to send a BEM message is, (1) vehicle did not receive BRO message in 5s since vehicle transmitting BRO=0xAA, or (2) did not receive CRO=0xAA within 60s. Although vehicle send BEM message, the charging process did not satisfy any of the conditions for the vehicle to send a BEM message. Besides, the BEM message report Other Fault instead of Receiving CRO message timeout, which is incorrect.

This happens in case of: * an app is deactivated by appActivator (application specified reasons) * an audio source is removed (e.g. bluetooth audio when phone disconnects) * digital premium is enabled/disabled and the app is providing a different app-entry/icon for it's app (e.g. doors_and_windows app) This last reason is seen here. The doors_and_windows app, which relates to this shortcut, was disabled because the shown entry in all-apps has a different launch_id defined, than the app-entry, where the shortcut was created from. There was recently a fix on doors_and_windows app regarding this issue. We close this ticket as duplicate of HU22DM-348154, HU22DM-347304. Even these tickets show a different problem, the root cause is a different launch_id for premium and non-premium app on doors_and_windows app-entry. This will send a LOSS_TRANSIENT to PEnt. After answering the call, since Evo abandons the call ring focus, a gain will be sent to PEnt and the previously connected source will start connecting and will send the requestAudioFocus to Evo. In the meantime, Evo will start connecting call. This will cause the request audio focus from PEnt to be rejected since Evo will be in a call. This focus rejection will result in a LOSS_TRANSIENT for media (it will be media since it was the source that was requested by PEnt). Actual (failed) result/behavior (problem description) Users can open the car door with the key, and after getting in, the account information displayed is that of the main user's account. After clicking on the carplay app, a prompt appears indicating that the car key is not in the car, even though the car key is inside. However, pressing the unlock button on the key produces an unlock sound, and pressing the trunk opening button opens the trunk. Recovery action: Note: Before getting in the car, the vehicle was logged in with a guest account. If the user uses the key bound to the main account to unlock and get in the car, and the main account information is successfully displayed, this proves that the key has been recognized. However, after clicking on the carplay app, an incorrect pop-up appears indicating the absence of the key. Additionally, this issue also occurs when switching between the main account and guest account, and the solution is to start the engine.
